name: blur-scrim
title: Blur Scrim
description: A blur-and-dim layer that covers its container instead of the page, with content centred on top. Click or Escape dismisses it; no fade under reduced motion.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether the scrim covers its container.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the scrim is clicked or Escape is pressed.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur of the covered content in pixels.

props.name: dim
props.description: How strongly the background colour dims it, 0 to 1.

props.name: children
props.description: Content centred on top of the scrim.
